verdict.rationale: Mercury Books ships a built-in AI assistant, Command, which users can ask questions and delegate bookkeeping tasks to directly ("hand off a bookkeeping task to it directly, in plain language"; "Let Command clear the backlog — Offload work like writing journal entries, organizing your chart of accounts, categorization in bulk"). This is first-party product documentation of task delegation, not just Q&A. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Command's delegation reliability, and Mercury's own caveat that automation is a 'starting point' rather than full autopilot tempers the scope of delegation.
